1.1: Words of Amos--who has been among herdsmen of Tekoa--that he has seen concerning Israel, in the days of Uzziah king of Judah, and in the days of Jeroboam son of Joash king of Israel, two years before the shaking;
1.2: and he says: Jehovah from Zion does roar, And from Jerusalem gives forth His voice, And mourned have pastures of the shepherds, And withered has the top of Carmel!
1.3: And thus said Jehovah: For three transgressions of Damascus, And for four, I do not reverse it, Because of their threshing Gilead with sharp-pointed irons,
1.4: And I have sent a fire against the house of Hazael, And it has consumed the palaces of Ben-Hadad.
1.5: And I have broken the bar of Damascus, And cut off the inhabitant from Bikat-Aven, And a holder of a sceptre from Beth-Eden, And removed have been the people of Aram to Kir, said Jehovah.
1.6: Thus said Jehovah: For three transgressions of Gaza, And for four, I do not reverse it, Because of their removing a complete captivity, To deliver up to Edom,
1.7: And I have sent a fire against the wall of Gaza, And it has consumed her palaces;
1.8: And I have cut off the inhabitant from Ashdod, And a holder of a sceptre from Ashkelon, And have turned back My hand against Ekron, And perished have the remnant of the Philistines, Said the Lord Jehovah.
1.9: Thus said Jehovah: For three transgressions of Tyre, And for four, I do not reverse it, Because of their delivering up a complete captivity to Edom, And they remembered not the brotherly covenant,
1.10: And I have sent a fire against the wall of Tyre, And it has consumed her palaces.
1.11: Thus said Jehovah: For three transgressions of Edom, And for four, I do not reverse it, Because of his pursuing with a sword his brother, And he has destroyed his mercies, And tear perpetually does his anger, And his wrath--he has kept it for ever,
1.12: And I have sent a fire against Teman, And it has consumed palaces of Bozrah.
1.13: Thus said Jehovah: For three transgressions of the sons of Ammon, And for four, I do not reverse it, Because of their ripping up the pregnant ones of Gilead, To enlarge their border,
1.14: And I have kindled a fire against the wall of Rabbah, And it has consumed her palaces, With a shout in a day of battle, With a whirlwind in a day of hurricane,
1.15: And gone has their king in a removal, He and his heads together, said Jehovah!

2.1: Thus said Jehovah: For three transgressions of Moab, And for four, I do not reverse it, Because of his burning the bones of the king of Edom to lime,
2.2: And I have sent a fire against Moab, And it has consumed the palaces of Kerioth, And dying with noise is Moab, With shouting, with voice of a trumpet.
2.3: And I have cut off a judge from her midst, And all its heads I slay with him, said Jehovah.
2.4: Thus said Jehovah: For three transgressions of Judah, And for four, I do not reserve it, Because of their loathing the law of Jehovah, And His statutes they have not kept, And their lies do cause them to err, After which their fathers did walk,
2.5: And I have sent a fire against Judah, And it has consumed palaces of Jerusalem.
2.6: Thus said Jehovah: For three transgressions of Israel, And for four, I do not reverse it, Because of their selling for silver the righteous, And the needy for a pair of sandals.
2.7: Who are panting for the dust of the earth on the head of the poor, And the way of the humble they turn aside, And a man and his father go to the damsel, So as to pollute My holy name.
2.8: And on pledged garments they stretch themselves near every altar, And the wine of fined ones they drink in the house of their gods.
2.9: And I--I have destroyed the Amorite from before them, Whose height is as the height of cedars, And strong he is as the oaks, And I destroy his fruit from above, And his roots from beneath.
2.10: And I--I have brought you up from the land of Egypt, And cause you to go in a wilderness forty years, To possess the land of the Amorite.
2.11: And I raise of your sons for prophets, And of your choice ones for Nazarites, Is not this true, O sons of Israel? An affirmation of Jehovah.
2.12: And you cause the Nazarites to drink wine, And on the prophets you have laid a charge, Saying, `Do not prophecy!'
2.13: Indeed, I am pressing you under, As the full cart does press for itself a sheaf.
2.14: And perished has refuge from the swift, And the strong strengthens not his power, And the mighty delivers not his soul.
2.15: And the handler of the bow stands not, And the swift with his feet delivers not himself, And the rider of the horse delivers not his soul.
2.16: And the courageous of heart among the mighty, Naked does flee in that day, An affirmation of Jehovah!

3.1: Hear you this word that Jehovah has spoken concerning you, O sons of Israel, concerning all the family that I brought up from the land of Egypt, saying:
3.2: Only you I have known of all families of the land, Therefore I charge on you all your iniquities.
3.3: Do two walk together if they have not met?
3.4: Roar does a lion in a forest and prey he has none? Give out does a young lion his voice from his habitation, If he has not caught?
3.5: Does a bird fall into a snare of the earth, And there is no gin for it? Does a snare go up from the ground, And prey it captures not?
3.6: Is a trumpet blown in a city, And do people not tremble? Is there affliction in a city, And Jehovah has not done it?
3.7: For the Lord Jehovah does nothing, Except He has revealed His counsel to His servants the prophets.
3.8: A lion has roared--who does not fear? The Lord Jehovah has spoken--who does not prophesy?
3.9: Sound you to palaces in Ashdod, And to palaces in the land of Egypt, and say: Be you gathered on mountains of Samaria, And see many troubles within her, And oppressed ones in her midst.
3.10: And they have not known to act straightforwardly, An affirmation of Jehovah, Who are treasuring up violence and spoil in their palaces.
3.11: Therefore, thus said the Lord Jehovah: An adversary--and surrounding the land, And he has brought down from you your strength, And spoiled have been your palaces.
3.12: Thus said Jehovah: As the shepherd delivers from the lion's mouth Two legs, or a piece of an ear, So delivered are the sons of Israel, Who are sitting in Samaria on the corner of a bed, And in Damascus on that of a couch.
3.13: Hear you and testify to the house of Jacob, An affirmation of the Lord Jehovah, God of Hosts.
3.14: For in the day of My charging the transgressions of Israel on him, I have laid a charge on the altars of Beth-El, And cut off have been the horns of the altar, And they have fallen to the earth.
3.15: And I have smitten the winter-house with the summer-house, And perished have houses of ivory, And consumed have been many houses, An affirmation of Jehovah!

4.1: Hear this word, you kine of Bashan, Who are in the mountain of Samaria, Who are oppressing the poor, Who are bruising the needy, Who are saying to their lords: `Bring in, and we do drink.'
4.2: Sworn has the Lord Jehovah by His holiness, That indeed, days are coming upon you, And he has taken you away with hooks, And your posterity with fish-hooks.
4.3: And by breaches you go forth, A woman at that over-against her, And you have cast down the high place, An affirmation of Jehovah.
4.4: Enter you Beth-El, and transgress, At Gilgal multiply transgression, And bring in every morning your sacrifices, Every third year your tithes.
4.5: And perfume with leaven a thank-offering, And proclaim willing gifts, sound you! For so you have loved, O sons of Israel, An affirmation of the Lord Jehovah.
4.6: And I also--I have given to you cleanness of teeth in all your cities, And lack of bread in all your places, And you have not turned back to Me, an affirmation of Jehovah.
4.7: And I also--I have withheld from you the rain. While yet three months to harvest, And I have sent rain on one city, And on another city I do not send rain, One portion is rained on, And the portion on which it rains not withers.
4.8: And wandered have two or three cities, To the same city to drink water, And they are not satisfied, And you have not turned back to Me, An affirmation of Jehovah.
4.9: I have smitten you with blasting and with mildew, The abundance of your gardens and of your vineyards, And of your figs, and of your olives, Eat does the palmer-worm, And you have not turned back to Me, An affirmation of Jehovah.
4.10: I have sent among you pestilence by the way of Egypt, I have slain by sword your choice ones, With your captive horses, And I cause the stink of your camps to come up--even into your nostrils, And you have not turned back to Me, An affirmation of Jehovah.
4.11: I have overturned among you, Like the overturn by God of Sodom and Gomorrah, And you are as a brand delivered from a burning, And you have not turned back to Me, An affirmation of Jehovah.
4.12: Therefore, thus I do to you, O Israel, at last, Because this I do to you, Prepare to meet your God, O Israel.
4.13: For, indeed, the former of mountains, and creator of wind, And the declarer to man what is His thought, He is making dawn obscurity, And is treading on high places of earth, Jehovah, God of Hosts, is His name!

5.1: Hear this word that I am bearing to you, A lamentation, O house of Israel:
5.2: `Fallen, not again to rise, has the virgin of Israel, Left on her land--she has no raiser up.'
5.3: For thus said the Lord Jehovah: The city that is going out a thousand, Does leave an hundred, And that which is going out an hundred, Does leave ten to the house of Israel.
5.4: For thus said Jehovah to the house of Israel: Seek you Me, and live,
5.5: And seek not Beth-El, and Gilgal enter not, And Beer-Sheba pass not through, For Gilgal does utterly remove, And Beth-El does become vanity.
5.6: Seek you Jehovah, and live, Lest He prosper as fire against the house of Joseph, And it has consumed, And there is no quencher for Beth-El.
5.7: You who are turning to wormwood judgment, And righteousness to the earth have put down,
5.8: The maker of Kimah and Kesil, And the turner to morning of death-shade, And day as night He has made dark, Who is calling to the waters of the sea, And pours them on the face of the earth, Jehovah is His name;
5.9: Who is brightening up the spoiled against the strong, And the spoiled against a fortress comes.
5.10: They have hated a reprover in the gate, And a plain speaker they abominate.
5.11: Therefore, because of your trampling on the poor, And the tribute of corn you take from him, Houses of hewn work you have built, And you do not dwell in them, Desirable vineyards you have planted, And you do not drink their wine.
5.12: For I have known--many are your transgressions, And mighty your sins, Adversaries of the righteous, taking ransoms, And the needy in the gate you turned aside.
5.13: Therefore is the wise at that time silent, For an evil time it is.
5.14: Seek good, and not evil, that you may live, And it is so; Jehovah, God of Hosts, is with you, as you said.
5.15: Hate evil, and love good, And set up judgment in the gate, It may be Jehovah, God of Hosts, does pity the remnant of Joseph.
5.16: Therefore, thus said Jehovah, God of Hosts, the Lord, In all broad places is lamentation, And in all out-places they say, `Alas, alas,' And called the husbandman to mourning, And to lamentation the skilful of wailing.
5.17: And in all vineyards is lamentation, For I pass into your midst, said Jehovah.
5.18: Ho, you who are desiring the day of Jehovah, Why is this to you--the day of Jehovah? It is darkness, and not light,
5.19: As when one flees from the face of the lion, And the bear has met him, And he has come in to the house, And has leant his hand on the wall, And the serpent has bitten him.
5.20: Is not the day of Jehovah darkness and not light, Even thick darkness that has no brightness?
5.21: I have hated--I have loathed your festivals, And I am not refreshed by your restraints.
5.22: For though you cause burnt-offerings and your presents to ascend to Me, I am not pleased, And the peace-offering of your fatlings I behold not.
5.23: Turn aside from Me the noise of your songs, Yes, the praise of your psaltery I hear not.
5.24: And roll on as waters does judgment, And righteousness as a perennial stream.
5.25: Sacrifices and offering did you bring nigh to Me, In a wilderness forty years, O house of Israel?
5.26: And you bare Succoth your king, and Chiun your images, The star of your god, that you made for yourselves.
5.27: And I removed you beyond Damascus, Said Jehovah, God of Hosts is His name.

6.1: Woe to those secure in Zion, And those confident in the mount of Samaria, The marked of the chief of the nations, And come to them have the house of Israel.
6.2: Pass you over to Calneh and see, And go from there to Hamath the great, And go down to Gath of the Philistines, Are they better than these kingdoms? Greater is their border than your border?
6.3: Who are putting away the day of evil, And you bring nigh the seat of violence,
6.4: Who are lying down on beds of ivory, And are spread out on their couches, And are eating lambs from the flock, And calves from the midst of the stall,
6.5: Who are taking part according to the psaltery, Like David they invented for themselves instruments of music;
6.6: Who are drinking with bowls of wine, And with chief perfumes anoint themselves, And have not been pained for the breach of Joseph.
6.7: Therefore now they remove at the head of the captives, And turned aside is the mourning-feast of stretched-out ones.
6.8: Sworn has the Lord Jehovah by Himself, An affirmation of Jehovah, God of Hosts: I am abominating the excellency of Jacob, And his high places I have hated, And I have delivered up the city and its fulness.
6.9: And if there are left ten persons in one house, It has come to pass--that they have died.
6.10: And lifted him up has his loved one, even his burner, To bring forth the bones from the house, And he said to him who is in the sides of the house, `Is there yet with you?' And he said, `None,' then he said, `Hush! Save to make mention of the name of Jehovah.'
6.11: For indeed, Jehovah is commanding, And He has smitten the great house with breaches, And the little house with clefts.
6.12: Do horses run on a rock? Does one plough it with oxen? For you have turned to gall judgment, And the fruit of righteousness to wormwood.
6.13: O you who are rejoicing at nothing, Who are saying, `Have we not by our strength taken to ourselves horns?'
6.14: Surely, indeed, I am raising against you a nation, O house of Israel, An affirmation of Jehovah, God of Hosts, And they have oppressed you from the coming in to Hamath, To the stream of the desert.

7.1: Thus has the Lord Jehovah showed me, and indeed, He is forming locusts at the beginning of the ascending of the latter growth, and indeed, the latter growth is after the mowings of the king;
7.2: and it has come to pass, when it has finished to consume the herb of the land, that I say: `Lord Jehovah, forgive, I pray You, How does Jacob arise--for he is small?'
7.3: Jehovah has repented of this, `It shall not be,' said Jehovah.
7.4: Thus has the Lord Jehovah showed me, and indeed, the Lord Jehovah is calling to contend by fire, and it consumes the great deep, yes, it has consumed the portion, and I say:
7.5: `Lord Jehovah, cease, I pray You, How does Jacob arise--for he is small?'
7.6: Jehovah has repented of this, `It also shall not be,' said the Lord Jehovah.
7.7: Thus has He showed me, and indeed, the Lord is standing by a wall made according to a plumb-line, and in His hand a plumb-line;
7.8: and Jehovah says to me, `What are you seeing, Amos?' And I say, `A plumb-line;' and the Lord says: `Indeed, I am setting a plumb-line in the midst of My people Israel, I do not add any more to pass over to it.
7.9: And desolated have been high places of Isaac, And sanctuaries of Israel are wasted, And I have risen against the house of Jeroboam with a sword.'
7.10: And Amaziah priest of Beth-El sends to Jeroboam king of Israel, saying, `Amos has conspired against you in the midst of the house of Israel; the land is not able to bear all his words,
7.11: for thus said Amos: By sword die does Jeroboam, And Israel certainly removes from off its land.'
7.12: And Amaziah says to Amos, `Seer, go flee for you to the land of Judah, and eat there bread, and there you do prophesy;
7.13: and at Beth-El do not add to prophesy any more, for it is the king's sanctuary, and it is the royal house.'
7.14: And Amos answers and says to Amaziah, `I am no prophet, nor a prophet's son am I, but a herdsman I am, and a cultivator of sycamores,
7.15: and Jehovah takes me from after the flock, and Jehovah says to me, Go, prophesy to My people Israel.
7.16: And now, hear a word of Jehovah: you are saying, Do not prophesy against Israel, nor drop any thing against the house of Isaac,
7.17: therefore thus said Jehovah: Your wife in the city does go a-whoring, And your sons and your daughters by sword do fall, And your land by line is apportioned, And you on an unclean land die, And Israel certainly removes from off its land.'

8.1: Thus has the Lord Jehovah showed me, and, indeed, a basket of summer-fruit.
8.2: And He says, `What are you seeing, Amos?' and I say, `A basket of summer-fruit.' And Jehovah says to me: `The end has come to My people Israel, I do not add any more to pass over to it.
8.3: And howled have songstresses of a palace in that day, An affirmation of the Lord Jehovah, Many are the carcases, into any place throw--hush!
8.4: Hear this, you who are swallowing up the needy, To cause to cease the poor of the land,
8.5: Saying, When does the new moon pass, And we sell ground corn? And the sabbath, and we open out pure corn? To make little the ephah, And to make great the shekel, And to use perversely balances of deceit.
8.6: To purchase with money the poor, And the needy for a pair of sandals, Yes, the refuse of the pure corn we sell.
8.7: Sworn has Jehovah by the excellency of Jacob: `I forget not for ever any of their works.
8.8: For this does not the land tremble, And mourned has every dweller in it? And come up as a flood has all of it. And it has been cast out, and has sunk, Like the flood of Egypt.
8.9: And it has come to pass in that day, An affirmation of the Lord Jehovah, I have caused the sun to go in at noon, And caused darkness on the land in a day of light,
8.10: And have turned your festivals to mourning, And all your songs to lamentation, And caused sackcloth to come up on all loins, And on every head--baldness, And made it as a mourning of an only one, And its latter end as a day of bitterness.
8.11: Indeed, days are coming, An affirmation of the Lord Jehovah, And I have sent a famine into the land, Not a famine of bread, nor a thirst of water But of hearing the words of Jehovah.
8.12: And they have wandered from sea to sea, And from north even to east, They go to and fro to seek the word of Jehovah, And they do not find.
8.13: In that day faint do the fair virgins, And the young men, with thirst.
8.14: Those swearing by the guilt of Samaria, And have said, Live does your god, O Dan, And, Live does the way of Beer-Sheba, And they have fallen--and rise not again!'

9.1: I have seen the Lord standing by the altar, and He says: `Smite the knob, and the thresholds shake, And cut them off by the head--all of them, And their posterity with a sword I do slay, Not flee to them does the fleer, Nor escape to them does a fugitive.
9.2: If they dig through into sheol, From from there does My hand take them, And if they go up the heavens, From from there I cause them to come down.
9.3: And if they be hid in the top of Carmel, From from there I search out, and have taken them, And if they be hid from My eyes in the bottom of the sea, From from there I command the serpent, And it has bitten them.
9.4: And if they go into captivity before their enemies, From from there I command the sword, And it has slain them, And I have set My eye on them for evil, And not for good.
9.5: And it is the Lord, Jehovah of Hosts, Who is striking against the land, and it melts, And mourned have all the inhabitants in it, And come up as a flood has all of it, And it has sunk--like the flood of Egypt.
9.6: Who is building in the heavens His upper chambers; As to His troop, Upon earth He has founded it, Who is calling for the waters of the sea, And pours them out on the face of the land, Jehovah is His name.
9.7: As sons of Cushim are you not to Me? O sons of Israel--an affirmation of Jehovah. Israel did I not bring up out of the land of Egypt? And the Philistines from Caphtor, and Aram from Kir?
9.8: Indeed, the eyes of the Lord Jehovah are on the sinful kingdom, And I have destroyed it from off the face of the ground, Only, I destroy not utterly the house of Jacob, An affirmation of Jehovah.
9.9: For indeed, I am commanding, And I have shaken among all the nations the house of Israel, As one does shake with a sieve, And there falls not a grain to the earth.
9.10: By sword die do all sinners of My people, Who are saying, `Not overtake, or go before, For our sakes, does evil.'
9.11: In that day I raise the tabernacle of David, that is fallen, And I have repaired their breaches, And its ruins I do raise up, And I have built it up as in days of old.
9.12: So that they possess the remnant of Edom, And all the nations on whom My name is called, An affirmation of Jehovah--doer of this.
9.13: Indeed, days are coming--an affirmation of Jehovah, And come nigh has the ploughman to the reaper, And the treader of grapes to the scatterer of seed, And the mountains have dropped juice, And all the hills do melt.
9.14: And I have turned back to the captivity of My people Israel, And they have built desolate cities, and inhabited, And have planted vineyards, and drunk their wine, And made gardens, and eaten their fruit.
9.15: And I have planted them on their own ground, And they are not plucked up any more from off their own ground, That I have given to them, said Jehovah your God!
